links.outcome: LLM accuracy compared across the two institutions
links.effect: No significant difference in accuracy by originating institution or by presence of synchronous upper GI endoscopy data.
links.quote: There was no significant difference in accuracy based on the institution from which the data originated or the presence of synchronous upper gastrointestinal endoscopy data within the pathology report impression.

links.outcome: Accuracy reproducibility across 10 repeated runs with identical model, prompt, and dataset
links.effect: Average accuracy was 94.6% across 10 experiments; authors describe accuracy as consistently high.
links.quote: LLMs with a custom prompt achieve consistently high accuracy in determining the guideline-based surveillance colonoscopy interval.

unlisted_practices: Embedding the guideline algorithm (US Multi-Society Task Force) in a custom prompt to improve guideline-concordant surveillance interval recommendations

screen.reason: Retrospective multicenter validation study evaluating the performance/accuracy of GPT-4o with a custom prompt to determine surveillance colonoscopy intervals from endoscopy and pathology reports.
